simple.summary: שֶׂכְוִי (sekvîy) means observant , i.e. (concretely) the mind First listed occurrence: Job 38 36.

definitions.full: H7907. sekvi שֶׂכְוִי noun [masculine] perhaps a celestial appearance, phenomenon (Rabb Thes mind ; De (after Talmud) cock (compare Late Hebrew שֶׂכְוִי cock , שֶׂכְוְיָה hen , foreign words accusative Dalm), Di 'Wolkengebilde'); — absolute ׳שׂ perhaps of clouds (compare || טֻחִוֺת ) Job 38:36 (RVm meteor ).
